The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) taught that spouses should beautify themselves for each other and express affection through words and actions. Compliments are a simple yet meaningful way to affirm love and respect. Withholding a compliment solely because your wife additionally got a pedicure (a form of self-care) is unnecessary and could unintentionally hurt her feelings. But the *reason given* ("because she went for a pedicure afterwards") is not valid in Islamic ethics, as it trivializes her effort. Always strive to affirm your spouse’s efforts. 💛
